python.imports:
import fluentqt
from PySide6.QtCore import QRect, QSize, Qt
from PySide6.QtGui import QColor, QFont, QIcon, QLinearGradient, QPainter, QPixmap
python.setup:
control = fluentqt.SplashScreen(%PARENT%)
emblem = QPixmap(112, 112)
emblem.setDevicePixelRatio(2.0)
emblem.fill(Qt.GlobalColor.transparent)
ep = QPainter(emblem)
ep.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing)
grad = QLinearGradient(0.0, 0.0, 56.0, 56.0)
grad.setColorAt(0.0, QColor("#3AA8FF"))
grad.setColorAt(1.0, QColor("#0067C0"))
ep.setPen(Qt.PenStyle.NoPen)
ep.setBrush(grad)
ep.drawRoundedRect(0, 0, 56, 56, 14, 14)
ep.setPen(Qt.GlobalColor.white)
ef = ep.font()
ef.setPixelSize(30)
ef.setBold(True)
ep.setFont(ef)
ep.drawText(QRect(0, 0, 56, 56), Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter, "F")
ep.end()
control.setIcon(QIcon(emblem))
control.setIconSize(QSize(56, 56))
control.show()
